canonical_claim: Let X be a normal projective variety over a characteristic-zero field, Delta an effective Q-divisor such that K_X+Delta is Q-Cartier and (X,Delta) is klt, and D a Cartier divisor. If D-(K_X+Delta) is nef and big, then H^i(X,O_X(D)) vanishes for every i>0.
encoding_boundary: The pinned mathlib snapshot supplies Scheme and Spec, but lacks the combined native interfaces for Q-divisors, canonical divisors, klt pairs, nefness/bigness of divisors, divisorial sheaves, and their coherent cohomology. KawamataViehwegData types these objects and names their semantic compatibility predicates. None of its fields assumes any cohomology vanishing conclusion.

conclusion: Subsingleton (V.cohomology V.D i), encoding H^i(X,O_X(D)) = 0, for every positive natural degree i
degenerate_cases: Degree zero is excluded from the conclusion. Dimension zero is not excluded. The base field is arbitrary of characteristic zero and is not silently restricted to an algebraically closed field or C.
